claims.statement: For exact rank three and an invertible original physical pair B, the Schur complement is lambda h h^T with unit background vector h and lambda=det(Lambda)tau/det(B); moreover det A[I union {k}]=det(Lambda)tau h_k^2 and the absolute principal-triple packet sums to |det Lambda|tau.
If H has density cap L then sup_a E|H^2-a|^(-1/4)<=2sqrt(2L).

For exact rank three and an invertible indefinite original physical pair, ||p_Q||inf <=4sqrt(6)e^(1/4)|det B|^(-1/8)(|det Lambda|tau)^(-1/4), reducing the r33 determinant loss from exponent 3/8 to 1/8 by spending the exact third Schur square.
If eta=max h_k^2, a physical principal triple has determinant magnitude |det Lambda|tau eta, hence ||p_Q||inf<=104.217/[s_3(A)(tau eta)^(1/3)].

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For the exact unit Schur-normal coefficient vector h on the original background product bank, ||p_(h^T X)||inf<=sqrt(e); inserted into the square quarter-potential to obtain the 4sqrt(6)e^(1/4) compiler constant.

new_source_checkpoint_read.reason: Its grouped-hub receiver needs an actual physical split with the stated cross-rank/product and projected-volume row-marginal gates; the r35 Schur identity alone does not certify those gates.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-DIFFUSE-SCHUR-NORMAL-NEARRANKONE-v1: when the normalized pair determinant and max coordinate of the exact Schur normal are both small, aggregate the two shear projections together with h^T X before any pair-fiber maximum and remove the remaining determinant exponent; arbitrary higher-rank tails remain a separate extension debt.
